newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca down, SGST advises trim holdings.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca down, SGST advises trim holdings.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Plc dropped on Tuesday amid sporadic profit-taking and as analysts at SG Strauss Turnbull advised investors to "top-slice" their holdings, traders said.

The stock was down 18-1/2p at 15.37-1/2 stg by 1309 GMT -- extending their retreat from the intraday record of 15.91 stg, set September 9, amid the latest bout of speculation that the company could be target of a takeover bid. "Having performed very strongly we are seeing a bit of profit-taking," said one trader.
Analysts at SGST were not immediately available for comment.
